Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset: one standalone photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, action 160 T-AXU-026 step s01, supported one-arm light dumbbell row START POSITION.
The three supplied reference images are ONLY identity/wardrobe/background/photographic-style references. Match the same adult East Asian woman, natural face, black ponytail, white short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt and dark charcoal gray long trousers. Do not copy the arm poses in those references.
Scene: clean blue-gray seamless studio background and floor, soft even studio lighting and realistic gentle floor shadows, no wall clutter.
Pose: The woman stands facing toward image right at a stable fixed rectangular waist-height table. BOTH FEET remain fully flat on the floor, shoulder-width comfortable stance, a modest stagger is okay. LEFT palm is planted firmly flat on the tabletop with fingers clearly contacting it. The table has a sturdy visible solid base and a simple neutral light gray surface. She hinges at the hips, hips back, knees softly bent, natural neutral back and long relaxed neck, torso inclined forward about 35–45 degrees from vertical. Her RIGHT hand holds a single compact light gray dumbbell with a visible short grip between two modest weights. RIGHT arm hangs naturally downward under the shoulder, elbow nearly extended without locking; dumbbell near knee height. Her head follows the torso comfortably, gaze slightly forward/down. No braced hyperextension, no back rounding.
Camera: fixed slightly front-right oblique side angle from her RIGHT side so the right dumbbell arm is in foreground and the left support hand remains clearly visible on the table beyond. Full body composition including complete head, both hands, both feet, floor contact, whole dumbbell and the table support, no cropping. Show the support relation unambiguously. Natural anatomy and body proportions, hands correctly gripping. Landscape 3:2 composition with modest empty blue-gray space.
Only ONE woman and ONE frozen pose. No labels, text, numbers, arrows, lines, diagrams, panels, split-screen, ghost limbs, motion blur, watermark or logos. No knee on table, no second dumbbell.
